results.title: Executioner
results.overview: A high profile politician foils a blackmail plot and devises a shocking plan for retribution. Based on the hit play 'Deadlock'.

results.title: Renate
results.overview: With over 90 works, 87-year-old Renate Welsh is one of the most influential authors in Austrian children's and young adult literature. The film follows her eventful life - from a childhood filled with guilt to her literary work alongside Christine Nöstlinger and Mira Lobe, giving a voice to marginalized outsiders. In her writer's workshops she supports homeless people or farmers with little connection to writing to find their own voice. But a sudden stroke robs her of her own voice and mobility. A touching portrait of an extraordinary author who overcomes both her own and others' silence - never ceasing to tell stories.

results.title: pigeonhole
results.overview: An insecure actress recovering from a secret nose job on a quiet Spanish island, confronts the harshest critic of all - herself.

results.title: FLORID
results.overview: Jamal, a young man who hears voices, struggles to balance his medication with his musical ambitions and romantic desires.

results.title: How to Clean a House in Ten Easy Steps
results.original_title: How to Clean a House in Ten Easy Steps
results.overview: A mother and daughter create a shared fantasy to explore their intertwined experiences of immigration, labor, and womanhood.

results.title: Eye Tag
results.overview: Two strangers meet through a single glance, and what begins as a fleeting moment quickly becomes something that feels like love at first sight. As their eyes meet, a story begins to unfold... a story filled with romance, connection, and the possibility of a future together. Sometimes, all it takes is one look to imagine what could be.

results.title: The Shedding
results.overview: When his lover, a rising actor, leaves him for his own stand-in, Jean spirals into doubt and obsession. Caught between dream and reality, on a chaotic film set where everything is an illusion, he embarks on a troubling quest. Must he reinvent himself to win him back, or risk losing himself entirely?

results.title: Jack-O 2: Blood Moon Rising
results.overview: sequel to the VHS rental classic Jack-O

results.title: He Who Saw the Abyss
results.overview: The gun pointed at the head is a delirium that expands into disorderly controlled chaos. “He Who Saw the Abyss” by Gregorio Gananian and Negro Leo, is like a car that enters the curve at 300km/h, but slowly. In an experimental whirlwind, moving between a noisy sound and an almost idyllic musicality, the film is structured out of a pile of images that seem as intimate as they are delirious, accelerating into a trance that is fragmented by a montage, signed by João Dumans and Gregorio Gananian, who strive to articulate an intense experience on the big screen.

results.title: Bigfeels
results.overview: After being abandoned by their father on a winter camping trip, siblings Beck and Lexi must mend their relationship when a sought-after cryptid enters their lives.

results.title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
results.original_title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
results.overview: Jeanie, who is homeless, works from her car in a dubious network marketing job. When she is invited to her old school friends' bachelorette party, she senses an opportunity to sell them her products. But she has underestimated how much she wants to finally be part of the group again.

results.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
results.overview: A man, desperate to prove his sanity, confesses the terrible act he committed. What began as a quiet obsession with an old man’s eye slowly unravels into paranoia, dread, and the unbearable weight of guilt.

results.title: Bibahito Jiboner Dinguli
results.overview: A heartfelt family drama that captures the joys, struggles, and emotional moments of married life through love, sacrifice, and understanding.

results.title: Piano Day 2026
results.overview: With the participation of Aloïse Sauvage, Madeleine Cazenave, Joep Beving, Legowelt, and Chloé Antoniotti, ARTE Concert celebrates Piano Day with a musical stroll through the new spaces of the Théâtre Nanterre-Amandiers.

results.title: Children of the Monkey
results.overview: Dario, father of a disabled child, begins to receive attention from his brother's teenage son, discovering that he prefers him to his own. In the growing complicity with his nephew he finds the son he would have liked to have, he takes on the role of the father he could have been. An illusory and dangerous role-playing game that will put the entire family at risk.

results.title: Pelo Lindo
results.overview: On her 90th birthday, Josefa Elizabeth Andrade reflects on the chapel she built for her son, Joaquín Rodas Andrade, forcibly disappeared during Guatemala’s armed conflict nearly forty years ago.

results.title: Gravy
results.overview: Shust and his friends commit small-time scams for a living, taking advantage of any opportunity that comes their way. Meeting Ulyanov, the former Soviet Union shot put champion, and his daughter opens Shust's eyes to a completely different way of living. But under his gang's pressure, he uses Ulyanov to plan a heist on a Buryat jade-trading commune.

results.title: Love and Money
results.overview: Love and money, money, money make the world go round, but there’s more of the former on display in this winning exercise in DIY filmmaking from writer-director David Ray (Grand Unified Theory) and his puckish band of merry pranksters. This is a totally improvised jape, made in Vancouver “for less than the cost of a used Honda.” Andrew McNee plays Andrew, a musician whose lost his way — not to mention his friend Scott, who’s missing. Seeking him out involves strange encounters with friends and strangers, none of whom seems to know what’s going on (probably because there wasn’t a script). But go with it! There’s gold in them thar hills, and despite or because of its eccentric genesis, this completely unexpected movie actually goes somewhere…

results.title: Reflex
results.overview: A teenager finds himself in a bloody quest for vengeance after his dirtbike is stolen by a group of gangsters with a kidnapped child.

results.title: Bhagdaud
results.overview: The relentless rat race of life, exploring the struggles and ambitions of individuals navigating the complexities of their modern existence.
